name: How long does the pre-foreclosure process usually take in Florida?

mainEntity.name: How long does the pre-foreclosure process usually take in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Florida, the pre-foreclosure process typically involves a 'Notice of Default' followed by a period where the lender can file a foreclosure lawsuit. As Florida is a judicial foreclosure state, the entire process, from the first missed payment to the final sale, can take several months to over a year, depending on court backlogs and the complexity of the case. Homeowners should act quickly once they receive a Notice of Default, as the longer you wait, the fewer options may be available. acceptedAnswer.description: In Florida, pre-foreclosure to final sale can take months to over a year due to judicial process. Early action is key once a Notice of Default is received.
